req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that when a task is created without specifying the 'completed' field, it should default to 'false'. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_default_completed_false
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with only the title and description fields.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post('/tasks/', json={
    'title': 'Test Task',
    'description': 'This is a test task.'
})

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()['completed'] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ without the title field.
expected: The response JSON contains validation error for missing title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post('/tasks/', json={
    'description': 'This is a test task without a title.'
})

assert response.status_code == 422
assert 'title' in response.json()['detail'][0]['loc']

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of exactly 100 characters.
expected: The response JSON contains the correct title and 'completed': false.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

long_title = 'T' * 100
response = client.post('/tasks/', json={
    'title': long_title,
    'description': 'Boundary test for title length.'
})

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()['title'] == long_title
assert response.json()['completed'] is False
